predecessors.name: Sultanate of Johor
predecessors.text: Pahang, whose fourth raja bendahara Tun Ali 'renounced his allegiance to the Sultan of Johor' in 1853

successors.name: British Colonial Empire
successors.text: Pahang under a British Resident from October 1888, in the Federated Malay States from July 1895

ledger.x: 1853: Bendahara Tun Ali renounces allegiance to the Sultan of Johor and Pahang stands alone.
1853: Pahang leaves Johor's nominal union (in place since 1623, Pahang Sultanate page).
1881: the Bendahara state becomes a Sultanate again.
1888: Sultan Ahmad accepts a British Resident and Pahang passes under British control.

wars.name: Pahang Civil War
wars.outcome: After Tun Ali's death in 1857 his younger son Wan Ahmad challenged his half-brother Tun Mutahir; 'Wan Ahmad emerged victorious, establishing control over important towns and expelled his brother in 1863.'

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary for Pahang; the Johor, Terengganu, Kelantan, Perak and Selangor frontiers are approximate.
